messages:
alex: Heads-up: starting migration of our CI runner topology next week. We're splitting the single shared self-hosted runner pool into three dedicated pools (core-services, infra-tools, experiments) and moving to label-based routing. Goal is better isolation and predictable capacity for Dedicated customers. Migration window: Mon 2026-05-11 -> Fri 2026-05-15.

alex: Key changes you need to know:
- New runner labels: `runner:core`, `runner:infra`, `runner:exp`.
- Workflows must target the new labels (search/replace `self-hosted` -> `runner:...`).
- We will enable autoscaling on the infra/tools pools and cap the experiments pool to limit spend.
- Old shared pool will be decommissioned on 2026-05-22.

alex: Action items for teams: update 1–3 high-traffic workflows by EOD 2026-05-12; opt into canary by annotating PRs with `ci-canary: true`. If you rely on custom runners (sgx builds, gpu), ping infra to get dedicated capacity. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/ci/runner-migration (detailed checklist + terraform snippets).

priya: Quick q — does this affect Actions that use `runs-on: ubuntu-latest`?

alex: No immediate change for hosted runners (`ubuntu-latest`). This only affects self-hosted workflows currently targeting our shared runner pool. If your job had `runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]` you'll need to update to `runs-on: [runner:core, linux]` or similar.

mateo: Will PATs or secrets need rotation? We use a few repo-level deployment tokens in infra-tooling.

jenna: We should rotate any token that was scoped to the old runner manager. Infra will rotate those and publish new vault paths — we'll post PRs in infra/terraform for consumers.

samir: Can we get a lightweight sed one-liner for migration?

alex: Sure — example (test before running):
```
find . -name "*.yml" -exec sed -i "s/runs-on: \[self-hosted/ runs-on: [runner:core/" {} +
```
Replace `runner:core` with the pool you want.

priya: Are third-party actions impacted if they spawn services? e.g., `setup-minikube` that requires privileged runners.

jenna: We'll tag a subset of infra runners as `privileged:true` for those jobs. If you need privileged access, open an ops ticket and include the repo + workflow path.

ops-bot: NOTICE: Canary cohort opens 2026-05-11 09:00 UTC for repos annotated with `ci-canary: true`. Metrics dashboards will be created under Console -> CI -> Runner Migration.

mateo: Will there be automatic fallback to the hosted runners if the new labels aren't available?

alex: No automatic fallback by default. We opted to avoid silent host fallbacks for security and predictability. You can add conditional jobs or use matrix strategies if you want cross-runner fallbacks. We're open to adding an opt-in fallback policy if enough teams request it.

priya: Is there any change to audit logging for runner jobs?

samir: We'll stream runner-heartbeat and job-assignment logs to Splunk. Retention for migration-related logs will be 90 days.

jenna: Terraform note: runner pool resources now live in `infra/runner-pools` with new variables `pool_name`, `labels`, `max_size`, and `privileged`. We'll land a PR that adds examples. Please review if you manage terraform modules that touch runners.

alex: Rollout plan:
- 2026-05-11: Enable new pools, canary cohort.
- 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-14: Gradual onboarding per-team (we'll DM maintainers).
- 2026-05-15: Lift canary, open migration for all repos.
- 2026-05-22: Decom old shared pool (final cutoff).

mateo: timeline acked — i'll update the top 10 repos we own and subscribe to the canary.

priya: I'll coordinate with SDKs team to update CI templates and create a migration PR template.

alex: Thanks — if you hit breaks, ping #eng-oncall or DM me. We'll have on-call coverage during the migration days and a short status stand-up 09:30 UTC each migration day in #eng.

sre-bot: INCIDENT-POST: no incidents currently. Will post any regressions to this thread.

jenna: small ask — can we get a list of repos currently using `self-hosted`? I can run a grep but it'd be nice if infra can provide a golden list.

ops-bot: TASK: infra will publish an inventory export by 2026-05-08 17:00 UTC. File will be at: https://redwood.internal/infra/runner-inventory.csv

alex: Appreciate everyone's help. This should make CI more reliable and reduce noisy interference across teams. :rocket: 

priya: ACK :thumbsup:
